criteria.text: The CLI prints one row per Linear team, each with exactly one of the five words, against live Linear.
criteria.recipe: export PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.14.1/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && node scripts/stage.mjs --json > /tmp/stage.json && node -e 'const r=require("/tmp/stage.json"); const w=new Set(["Planning","Research","Develop","Production","Done"]); if(r.ok!==true||r.teams.length<1) process.exit(1); for(const t of r.teams){ if(!w.has(t.stage)) process.exit(2) } console.log(r.teams.length+" teams, all words valid")'
